text: WestCoast Coffee Traders 0 Skip to Content WestCoast Coffee Traders Order Now Open Menu Close Menu WestCoast Coffee Traders Order Now Open Menu Close Menu We are Canadian Importers of Specialty Green Coffee. WestCoast Coffee Traders is a family-owned and operated Specialty Coffee Importer located in Western Canada. After importing our first single container directly from origin in 1992, we have had continuous growth year after year offering various types of specialty green coffee from around the world. With decades of experience, regular visits to growing regions, and an overall commitment to responsible coffee, we’ve been able to build personal relationships with producers. This allows access to the world’s most sought after green coffee beans. Small or large, near or far, we recognize that every Roaster is unique. We want to better understand your individual green coffee needs to help guide and make the correct purchasing decisions. We advocate that coffee should have a positive impact from farm to cup; WestCoast Coffee Traders values integrity, excellence and trust. We pride ourselves in building personal and long-lasting relationships with growers who we are proud to call partners. In return, WestCoast pays a premium to source ethical coffee that benefits our clients, the producers, their employees and the surrounding communities and environment where the coffee is grown. If you would like to learn more about our social initiatives or contribute to our efforts, please contact us as we would be happy to share more. If you are an existing client, you have already graciously contributed, we thank you for your continued support. We are always on the lookout for unique lots that are exclusive to our clients, and are committed to provide coffee you won’t find elsewhere in Canada. Please check our Spot Inventory as we are constantly receiving new coffee and our inventory is always changing. If you are looking for a specific type that we do not carry, please get in touch and we’ll do our best to secure it. Coffee Origins We offer a wide variety of specialty coffee from around the world. We purchase green coffee from, but not limited to, the Americas, Africa and Asia. Our sourcing model is simple: Specialty coffee + positive impact farm to cup. We are always interested in new partnerships and put no limits or borders in place. Tea Check our online tea inventory HERE WestCoast Coffee Traders is proud to sell specialty tea products. Get Get the app What is Cuppd? Cuppd is a specialty coffee discovery app for iPhone. Local roasters' coffees rarely make it to the shelves of big retail stores — you have to seek them out yourself, and hidden gems are easy to miss. Cuppd makes it easier to find your next favourite coffee, or to try something completely outside your comfort zone. Our goal is to map the world's best small-batch specialty roasters and their finest offerings. Suggest a coffee or roaster Email suggestion Where does the name come from? Cuppd comes from the word cupping — the professional tasting method used to evaluate coffee. The final d implies the past tense: the cupping is done, now it's time to rate. Is Cuppd the same as Cupp'd? No. Cuppd is a specialty coffee discovery app for iPhone, with its website at cuppdcoffee.com, cataloguing thousands of coffees from hundreds of independent roasters. It is not affiliated with Cupp'd, a separate coffee check-in app, or with any other similarly named product. Who is it for? Cuppd is not built for industry professionals or hardcore coffee nerds. It's for enthusiastic home baristas and coffee lovers who are curious and open to discovery. You don't need to log every millilitre of your brew to leave a review. Cuppd simply helps you figure out which coffee to try next. How do recommendations work? Based on your past ratings in the Cuppd app and our own methodology. We look at which coffees you enjoyed and which you didn't, identify patterns in their attributes, and use that to rank similar coffees higher or lower in your personal feed. Why we built it I've tried a lot of coffee. Some I loved, some not so much — but I couldn't figure out what they had in common, or what to look for next time. I started building Excel spreadsheets: logging every detail, scoring each coffee. That spreadsheet was essentially the first version of Cuppd. How we collect data Coffees are collected using AI-powered scraping. An AI model visits each roaster's webshop and gathers the relevant data for us. We take ethical guidelines seriously: we always check robots.txt , and if a roaster asks us not to scrape their site, they won't appear in our database. We also limit our crawl to product pages only — we don't traverse every corner of the site, so we keep server load to a minimum. How we're progressing We work country by country, mapping each roaster's catalogue. But this isn't a one-time job — every month we revisit and check for new products. 2026年6月13日 Coffee Guide編集部 初心者向け PR この記事には広告（アフィリエイトリンク）を含みます この記事のポイント 苦すぎる原因は過抽出（挽き目が細かい・温度が高い・時間が長い） 酸っぱすぎる原因は未抽出（挽き目が粗い・温度が低い・時間が短い） 調整は1変数ずつ——まず挽き目から変えると効果が分かりやすい コーヒーを淹れたら「なんか苦い」「酸っぱくて飲みにくい」——そんな経験は誰でもあるはずです。この悩みを解決するには、苦味と酸味が生まれる 原因 を理解することが第一歩です。 この記事では、苦すぎるコーヒーと酸っぱすぎるコーヒーのそれぞれの原因と、具体的な改善方法を解説します。 コーヒーの「良い苦味・酸味」と「悪い苦味・酸味」 まず前提として、コーヒーの苦味と酸味は本来「ネガティブな要素」ではありません。 良い苦味 ：チョコレートやキャラメルのような、風味の一部としての苦さ 悪い苦味 ：渋い・煙草のような・焦げたような不快な苦さ（過抽出のサイン） 良い酸味 ：フルーツのような明るい酸み、ワインのような豊かな酸み 悪い酸味 ：鋭くて刺さるような酸み、薄くて水っぽい（未抽出のサイン） 苦すぎるコーヒーの原因と対処法 苦味が強すぎる場合は 過抽出 が疑われます。過抽出とは、コーヒーから成分を引き出しすぎた状態です。 過抽出の見分け方 ・グラスの底まで重い苦味が続く ・飲み込んだあとに渋みが残る ・煙草のような焦げたような後味がある ・見た目が黒に近い濃い色 原因1：挽き目が細かすぎる 症状 ：苦味が強く、渋みもある。抽出時間も長くなりがち。 対処 ：グラインダーの設定を1〜2段粗くする。 これが最も効果的な改善方法です。挽き目を粗くするとお湯が抵抗なく通りやすくなり、過抽出が防げます。 原因2：湯温が高すぎる 症状 ：苦味が強く、香りが飛んだような印象がある。 対処 ：湯温を2〜3℃下げる。深煎り豆は86〜91℃が目安。 100℃に近い温度でドリップすると、苦味成分が過剰に溶け出します。 原因3：抽出時間が長すぎる 症状 ：じっくり注いだのに苦い、または抽出後期に苦みが増した。 対処 ：注湯のペースを速めるか、注湯回数を減らす。 ドリップの場合、液体がサーバーに落ちる時間が4分以上になると過抽出気味になることが多いです。 原因4：粉量が多すぎる・水量が少なすぎる 症状 ：全体的に濃くて重い。 対処 ：比率を1:15〜1:17の範囲で再設定する。 まとめ：過抽出の調整優先順位 まず 挽き目を粗く する 次に 湯温を下げる さらに改善しなければ 抽出時間を短く する 最後に 比率（粉量/水量）を見直す 酸っぱすぎるコーヒーの原因と対処法 酸味が強すぎる場合は 未抽出 が疑われます。未抽出とは、コーヒーから成分が十分に引き出されていない状態です。 未抽出の見分け方 ・一口目から鋭い酸みがあって後に続かない ・薄くて水っぽい味 ・コクや甘みがほとんど感じられない ・後味がすぐ消える 原因1：挽き目が粗すぎる 症状 ：抽出が速くて薄い、鋭い酸みが残る。 対処 ：グラインダーの設定を1〜2段細かくする。 原因2：湯温が低すぎる 症状 ：酸みが目立ち、甘みやコクが出てこない。 対処 ：湯温を90℃以上に上げる。浅煎り豆は90〜93℃が目安。 低温では甘みや複雑な成分が溶け出しにくく、酸味だけが先行して出てきます。 原因3：抽出時間が短すぎる 症状 ：さらっとした薄い液体で酸っぱい。 対処 ：注湯をゆっくりにするか、注湯回数を増やす。 ドリップの場合、2分以内に抽出が完了するのは速すぎます（2分30秒〜3分30秒が目安）。 原因4：蒸らしが不十分 症状 ：最初から最後まで味にムラがある。 対処 ：蒸らしを30〜45秒しっかり行う。 蒸らしが不十分だとCO2が残り、抽出が不均一になって酸味が際立ちます。 原因5：豆が古すぎる 症状 ：酸っぱいというより「平坦で抜け感のある」味。 対処 ：新鮮な豆（焙煎後2週間以内）に切り替える。 We source epic, traceable lots from good people and rely on natural, chemical-free processing methods to gently remove caffeine while preserving the bean's organic structure. The result is a clean, crisp, and smooth brew that stands up to any caffeinated counterpart. Does decaf coffee still contain caffeine? By industry standards, our specialty decaf coffee has 99.9% of its caffeine removed. A standard 250ml brewed cup contains roughly 2 to 5 milligrams of caffeine, compared to the 95 to 120 milligrams you would extract from a regular caffeinated brew. All our purchasing decisions are based around the selection of coffees that we love and find delicious, and that we’re excited to share. We work with dedicated and progressive producers, who care as much as we do about quality, and who produce exceptional coffees. We’re very proud of the relationships we’ve developed at origin, and we feel lucky to have worked with many of the same producers since 2008. Investing in these relationships has allowed us to increase quality potential, and enabled our producing partners to grow sustainably and continue to invest in improving quality. Visiting these producers every year enables us to understand the complexities and local challenges they face, and to find creative and meaningful ways to support them. We care a lot about supporting our customers – big and small – to help them grow, succeed and prosper. We love being part of a customer’s journey by providing the highest quality green beans and support along the way. Nothing makes us happier than seeing a customer get excited about our offerings, and fall in love with the coffees they’re roasting. We strive to build open and honest relationships with our customers, and to provide exceptional service and support. Ultimately, it’s our relationships, both locally and globally, that bring true meaning to what we do. We feel so lucky to be part of a vibrant and passionate coffee community, and we want to contribute to it in the most positive way we can. We add value and insight by providing as much traceability as possible on every single coffee we purchase. Wherever we can, we visit each of the producers we work with and develop long-term relationships with them. We share information with our customers about where our beans come from, how they are harvested and processed, and the backgrounds and stories of the people that grow them. We take our role as a link-builder between producers and purveyors seriously. We want to help our customers learn about our coffees and share these stories with their customers, to get everyone as excited about these coffees as we are. We believe everyone in the coffee chain can and should prosper, and that a focus on transparency and a commitment to paying premiums back to the producer is the best way to ensure a sustainable and viable future for coffee farming. By providing customers with an exceptional range of high quality, traceable coffees, and by investing heavily in education (both at the industry and consumer level), we hope to ignite positive change in the industry, and to continue to redefine what coffee is and can be, both in Australia and globally. But truth be told, all our amassed green coffee knowledge & know-hows, passed from generation to generation, is here to help deliver the liquid gold that makes consumers tick. Our History The blood, sweat & tears of Yeo Choon Bok. Our story began in the 1960s when Yeo Choon Bok & his wife, like most immigrants then, migrated to Singapore for a better future. He landed a job as an assistant storekeeper for a coffee trading house and slowly climbed his way up to eventually become a warehouse manager. The labour-intensive work was exhausting and he didn’t earn much. But he had 10 children to feed so he had no choice but to persevere. The family had to survive from pay cheque to pay cheque. Times were tough & to help make ends meet, his children had to earn their keep by picking defects out of coffee beans when they weren’t in school. Over time, the coffee trading house became one of Asia’s biggest trading firms. Sensing an opportunity, Choon Bok encouraged Henry, one of his sons, to join the company as a storekeeper. The tenacity of Henry Yeo. From his starting position as a storekeeper, Henry worked in store operations tirelessly for more than 10 years. It was a daily challenge but he was hungry for more. He wanted to cut his teeth into the core operation of the company: trading. So every evening when he was done with his daily tasks, he would join the trading desk to pick up the ropes. After 5 or so years of juggling both store operations & trading, he was recognised by his superiors and given a Trader position. Things were going smoothly & he strived. He eventually made Senior Trader. But alas, all good things must come to an end. In 1999, the Asian Financial Crisis hit hard. In the end, Henry was forced to venture out after 19 years. He went solo & started Young-In Traders in 2001. 20 years & beyond. Today, Young-In Traders have been in operation for more than 20 years. From a little shophouse at Jalan Senang, we have now grown to operate several warehouses at Kaki Bukit. All of this is run by a well-organised & experienced team that Henry still leads personally. 貯水槽でチェリーを回転させながら、軽い豆（未熟・欠点豆）を浮かせて取り除きます。 水洗・籠への移し替え 選別を経たチェリーを丁寧に水洗いし、次工程へ送る前に籠へ移します。 収穫後すぐに行う水槽での比重選別は、欠点豆を除去するスペシャルティコーヒー品質管理の要。Yosniyom Coffee Farmでは水洗いと選別を丁寧に重ねた後、Wash／Carbonic Maceration／Chaptalizationの各プロセスへと進みます。 標高 1,300〜1,350m 品種 Typica, Catimor 収穫 手摘み・完熟豆 COE 2024 4位（89.20点） ↗ COE 2025 8位（88.87点） ↗ COE 2026 National Winner 選出 Quality Control — Chiang Mai, Thailand Yosniyom Coffee Farm（ヨスニヨム農園） の品質管理プロセス コーヒーチェリーの受入れから5kg真空パックまで、 4回の選別 と徹底した衛生管理により、 欠点豆の少ないクリーンな生豆と、バッチごとに安定した高品質を実現しています。 チェリー 受入れ 標高1,300〜1,350mの圃場で手摘みされた完熟チェリーが、プロセスセンターに届きます。 選別 ① 洗浄・比重選別 農園がオーダーメイドで製作した洗浄機で洗浄。乾燥・軽量のチェリー（浮いたもの）を除去し、実の詰まったチェリーだけを選別します。 再洗浄 （洗浄工程） 選別された高品質なチェリーを、濾過した清浄な水で再度洗浄します。 選別 ② 発酵前 ハンドピック 目視で一粒ずつ確認し、未熟なチェリーを取り除きます。 発酵 各プロセスへ Wash／Carbonic Maceration／Natural Chaptalization など、各プロセスに応じた発酵を精密な環境管理のもとで行います。 選別 ③ 発酵後 ハンドピック 発酵後、再度また欠点や未熟なチェリーを取り除きます。 乾燥 天日・日陰で管理 天日と日陰を使い分け、温度・水分を細かくコントロールしながら乾燥させます。乾燥後は約30日間寝かせ（エイジング）、豆の水分を均一に落ち着かせてから脱殻します。 選別 ④ 最終選別 比重・色彩選別＋ハンドピック スクリーニングでサイズを揃え、比重選別機と色彩選別機で欠点豆を除去。最後にハンドピックで仕上げます。選別を終えた生豆は5kgずつ真空パックされます。 徹底した衛生管理 3段階の水濾過システム ここまで、すべてが順調だったわけではありません。定期便を始めた最初の一年は、思うように広がらない時期もありました。それでも続ける中で、少しずつ全国のお客様に届けられるようになりました。毎月受け取ってくださる方や、誰かに紹介してくださる方に支えられて、今があります。 Washing Station NATURAL & WASHED “맛있는 커피는 좋은 생두로부터 시작됩니다.” 아아! 커피의 기막힌 맛이여! 그건 천 번의 키스보다 멋지고, 마스카트의 술보다 달콤하다. J.S. BACH: Coffee Cantata BWV 211 에티코 생두 수입 과정 01. VISITING 매해 생두농장 및 워싱스테이션 방문 매해 현지를 방문하여 생두농장과 워싱스테이션을 돌아봅니다. 농장주와 직접 이야기하며 농장의 환경과 가공 과정, 체리의 색상과 크기 등을 확인합니다. 커피는 농작물인 만큼 수확되는 해의 날씨, 온도 등 기후 변화에 영향을 받기 때문에 해마다 체리의 상태를 확인하는 것이 매우 중요합니다. 02. 1ST CUPPING Quality Control 팀과 1차 선별 농장 방문 후 바로 진행되는 첫 번째 커핑은 다음 해에 들여올 생두를 선택하는 과정이라 더욱 신중하게 이루어집니다. Quality Control 팀과 함께 커핑 진행 후, 그 결과를 바탕으로 1차 선별합니다. 03. 2ND CUPPING 2차 선별 1차 선별한 생두들은 바로 국내에서 2차 커핑을 진행합니다. 수분, 밀도, 컬러, 결점두 등을 확인하여 수입할 생두들을 2차 선별합니다. 04. IMPORTING 생두 수입 각 생두 수출업체들의 자체 Quality inspection 과정을 거친 생두들은 다른 요인의 영향을 받지 않도록 Grainpro Bag에 포장되어 선적됩니다. 05. 3RD CUPPING 3차 커핑 1차, 2차 커핑 샘플과의 차이는 없는지, 운송과정 중에 변질은 없었는지 확인하기 위해 수입된 생두들은 Quality Control 팀에서 3차 커핑을 합니다. 06. La Palma El Tucan Colombia • PANAMA • Hacienda Barbara 로저스 페밀리 소유의 하시엔다 바바라 농장는 파나마에서 커피가 가장 잘 자라는 세 지역에서 20년 이상 스페셜티 커피를 재배해 왔습니다. 첫 번째 농장 보케테 지역의 바바라 농장은 하리미오의 해발 1450~1650미터에 위치해있으며 100년 된 나무 그늘이 있는 곳입니다. 농장 북쪽의 안개 낀 날과 찬 바람은 보케테에서 최고의 커피를 재배하기에 완벽한 환경을 조성합니다. 저희 에티코가 이번에 수입한 커피는 이 지역의 커피입니다. 그다음 농장들로는 보물이란 의미인 라 후아카 농장과 라스 브루아스 농장입니다. 각 각의 농장에선 우리가 잘 알고 있는 Best Of Panama 옥션 랏들이 해마다 출품되었고 좋은 성적을 거두었습니다. *Best Of Panama* (The results of the Barbara farms) 2016 BOP Traditional Washed 1st 2018 BOP Traditional Washed 2nd 2018 BOP Geisha Washed 5th 2019 BOP Traditional Washed 1st 2020 BOP Geisha Washed 4th 2020 BOP Geisha Natural 12th 2020 BOP Geisha Washed 14th 2021 BOP Geisha Washed 15th 이번에 수입된 커피는 게이샤 중에서도 그린팁 게이샤 품종으로 해발 1600미터에 위치한 "라 에스콘디다" 부지에서 수확되었습니다. 전통 워시드 프로세싱 된 커피를 아프리칸 베드에서 25일 동안 햇볕에 말렸습니다. 한 분야에서 지속적으로 꾸준한 성적을 거두는 것은 쉬운 일이 아닙니다. 베스트 오브 파나마에서 지속적으로 워시드 분야에 꾸준히 이름을 올려온 바바라 농장의 커피! 프로세싱으로 지친 당신의 미각에 아름다운 기억을 선물합니다. Hacienda Barbara Panama • PANAMA • Finca Lerida Finca Lerida는 1929년 파나마 최초로 독일에 커피를 수출한 만큼 오래되었습니다. 독일 드레스덴 왕립대 출신의 노르웨이 기술자 톨레프 바첼 묀니체(Bachel Möniche)는 파나마 운하 설계와 건설에 참여한 뒤 1911년 치리키 고지대를 여행하면서 볼칸바루 산자락과 센트럴 산맥의 높은 능선을 따라 둥지를 튼 곳이 지금의 핀카 레리다이고, 이 곳은 보케테에서 10km 떨어진 오르막길에 위치하고 있습니다. Finca Lerida는 현재 Amoruso Family가 경영하고 있으며 파나마 치리키(Chirquí), 보케테 지역 1600미터 이상에 위치한 5개 농장(Lérida, Esplendorosa, Amelia, El Salto, Flora)으로 구성되어 있습니다. 그중 main farm인 Lérida Estate는 1,900미터에 위치하고 있습니다. What we take on The team Partnerships at origin Connecting roasters to where great coffee starts Balzac Brothers is a small, independent, fourth-generation green coffee importer, family owned and operated. Balzac was founded in 1917, and our goal has not changed since: show up for the farm every year, and carry the risk between the harvest and the roaster. We believe in partnerships that are repeatable, scalable and mutually beneficial. Many of the farms and cooperatives on our offer list have sold to us for decades. We pay a premium above the market, and we keep buying through the hard years: a crop that did not come in the way it should, a container shortage, new tariffs, a pandemic. The roaster gets a farm they know by name. The farm gets a buyer who shows up every year. Explore our coffees Our vision To become true stewards of the coffee industry and to help all parties in our supply chain. We strive to earn the trust of our partners and to help them succeed in any way we can. Our values Remain honest and radically transparent with our partners Look out for all coffee people's best interests Build a healthy and inclusive coffee community Keep finding ways to be more sustainable Continue to run the firm as a family and independent business What we take on Balzac takes on the parts of the supply chain that sit between a harvest and your roastery: payments made on time to the farmer, the shipping, the risk, the quality control, the carrying cost, and the payment terms for your business. The point is a supply chain that holds up, for the farm in a hard year and for the roaster whose menu depends on a coffee arriving as promised. We have done that for 108 years. Buy at origin We commit to the crop with a contract before it ships, through long-term partnerships with producers, cooperatives and exporters. Carry the risk We insure the coffee on the water and the road, take on the shipping, the carrying cost and the credit risk, and work through it with the farm if something is off on arrival. Obsessive quality control Every lot is checked twice: a preshipment sample before it is bagged and loaded, and an arrival sample when it lands. Our Q Graders grade the green coffee, roast each sample to the same controlled profile and cup it side by side. Colombia Popayan Reserve The Region The Meseta de Popayan sits in the Pubenza valley in south-west Colombia, at around 1,700 metres. At that altitude the gap between day and night temperatures stays narrow all year, so cherries ripen slowly and evenly instead of racing through it. That is where the sweetness and the structure come from. Rainfall is high and dependable, and the soil is volcanic, built up from ash and mineral deposits laid down over thousands of years. Farms are small, typically five hectares or less, worked by families refining the same plots season after season. Popayan coffees are known for clarity and balance rather than the heavier, nuttier profile people often expect from Colombia. Flavour Profile Tasting Notes: Dark chocolate and milk chocolate lead the way, layered with red apple and ripe peach, finishing with a sweet, syrupy body. Body: Medium, smooth and creamy. Acidity: Balanced with a bright citrus lift. Process: Fully washed. Varieties: Castillo, Variedad Colombia, Caturra. Altitude: 1,700 to 1,900 metres. Backstory & Heritage Coffee reached Colombia in the late 1700s, carried in by Jesuit priests during the Spanish colonial period. The story usually told is of Father Francisco Romero, who is said to have set coffee planting as penance for his parishioners. It has almost certainly been embellished over two centuries, but the timeline holds, and cultivation spread quickly through the regions that suited it. Popayan's agricultural history runs much further back than that. Indigenous communities farmed this land long before coffee arrived, and a good deal of the local knowledge about soil behaviour and harvest timing traces to them. For us, sustainability means minimising our environmental impact, maximising our social impact and creating economic sustainability for coffee growers, café owners and coffee consumers.
